summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Sliding knob; moves to the end when on.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track filled with primary; thumb at the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute, or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl (SB-0101): setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked attribute, a disabled fieldset disables it and it is not submitted, <label for> on the host forwards the click to the inner input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px); the label beside it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009); it does not toggle, as in a native switch

aria: role="switch" on the inner input; on/off exposed as aria-checked through the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

coverage: label is the name; role switch; label click toggles
Space toggles, Enter does not; keyboard focus ring
checked paints differently and the thumb moves
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle
form value only while on, custom value, reset to attribute default, validity, disabled fieldset and re-enable, error customError, label for

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default border-input is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern (role switch, Space toggles), the visual reference for look and sizes, Checkbox contract for the form and field layout.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> or a custom element with role="switch" and ARIA state?
openQuestions.answer: Native input with role="switch" (native first, as Checkbox): it gives Space, focus, required validity and aria-checked for free. A custom role="switch" host would reimplement all of it.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, same as Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and may it be hidden?
openQuestions.answer: Required, with hide-label keeping it as the accessible name, same as Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20px track) and sm (24x16px), the reference sizes; token values already exist as size.switch.* in the semantic layer.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle?
openQuestions.answer: No. APG and native checkboxes use Space only; Enter submits the form (SB-0009).

openQuestions.question: What is submitted when off?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing, like a native checkbox; value (default "on") is submitted only while on.

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect as soon as it is flipped
The on/off value is submitted with a form
useCases.use: sb-switch with name (and value if not "on")

useCases.when: A smaller row, such as in a dense list

antiPatterns.pattern: A yes/no choice that is only recorded until the form is submitted
antiPatterns.why: Checkboxes record a choice; a switch reads as an immediate setting (checkbox contract)
A switch is a single on/off value
The label is the only name for the switch
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the setting
